messages:
maria: FYI — noticed multiple alerts after the roles refactor merged. Several services now have read access to project:analytics-bucket. Possibly role inheritance bug. Anyone else seeing this? :eyes:
ashok: looking. saw PR 3742 changed role-parent relations. checking IAM diff now.
dave: I see a policy delta on service-account:ingest-worker that adds `storage.objects.get` on analytics-bucket. It shouldn't have that.
ashok: root cause - the refactor replaced explicit deny with inherit-from-parent which pulls in `viewer` group from infra-org. oops.
jen: we should emergency-block access. propose adding a resource-based deny on bucket to strip inherited perms, then rollback the refactor patch.
maria: agree. steps: 1) apply deny 2) revoke long-lived tokens for affected service accounts 3) enable object-level audit logs 4) open ticket for postmortem.
deploy-bot: rolling out policy deny to gs://project-analytics-bucket (policy-id deny-190250) — started
ops-oncall: revoking tokens now: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete --ids <keys>` — done for ingest-worker/replicator
audit-bot: ALERT: KMS audit events for decrypt not being logged — KMS key policy lacks `roles/logging.logWriter` for audit service account. correlate with recent KMS policy change.
maria: great catch — that explains missing KMS decrypt logs for later access. Need to rotate key and fix key policy.
ashok: applying temporary deny succeeded, bucket read errors observed. rolling back role-refactor merge to a revert-PR to be merged once deny is stable.
dave: starting KMS key rotation and updating key policy: `gcloud kms keys versions create --key <key>` and adding `roles/logging.logWriter` to service account.
jen: notify product and CS — any customer-facing impacts? so far none, only internal services. i'll draft a short blurb.
maria: creating incident ticket INC-2026-452 and assigning owners: ashok (remediation), dave (kms), jen (comms), maria (postmortem).
ashok: patch pushed to revert - PR 3750, hold for canary verification then merge.
dave: once KMS rotated, re-issue new service account keys and update creds in secrets manager. will coordinate with ops-runbook.
maria: postmortem items: add integration test to prevent inheritance pulling viewer from org-root; require explicit allow exceptions; expand audit coverage for KMS decrypt events; short TTL for service account keys.
jen: +1 on comms. drafting note for customers: 'no customer data exposed, internal read-only service access was blocked within 10min' — will share copy.
ops-oncall: all mitigations complete. deny still in place. monitoring for regressions.
maria: closing thread for now. follow-up in INC-2026-452 and postmortem doc.
